subject.title: fix(gateway): stop accepting the Control UI token via ?token= query string

question: Should assistant-media query-token auth be removed immediately by this PR, or staged through a release-window compatibility/deprecation path?
rationale: The PR fixes a credential-in-URL security issue, but it also removes a shipped fallback path that related hardening work said was intentionally retained until scheduled removal.

options.title: Remove now after test refresh
options.body: Proceed with the security hardening in this PR once the stale current-base query-token tests are updated and the PR body captures the upgrade/release-note context.

options.title: Stage removal separately
options.body: Keep this PR paused and require a deprecation or migration plan before removing the fallback from shipped assistant-media URLs.

options.title: Retain fallback
options.body: Reject this removal for now and keep only the mediaTicket first-party path while accepting the remaining query-token exposure until a broader hardening PR lands.

recommendation.title: Remove now after test refresh
recommendation.body: Proceed with the security hardening in this PR once the stale current-base query-token tests are updated and the PR body captures the upgrade/release-note context.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the scoped media-ticket fix and is the clearest historical owner for the security-versus-compatibility timing decision.
